# Domain schema architecture/v0

Components and their connections, as `graph/v0`, for architecture and infrastructure. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/architecture/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/architecture/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/architecture/v0.json).

An extraction in this schema is an [extraction](extraction.md) whose `schema` is `architecture/v0`; the extraction schema applies this one
to it.

## Typed data

No typed `data` fields: every `data` field is open JSON.
